main_text.l: explicant, vt Confessio dicatur esse valida,
sic medico requisita ad morbum curandum
vidit huius rei testes a me productos Ioan-
rituales, & quod non minimi momenti est,
cum eo in loco Trapezuntius de idiotis, ho-
minibus sermonem habeat, qui eo amathiæ[?]
deuenere, vt ignorent, quid peccatum sit,
& longe cum sint a Canonum cognitione
non discernunt vitium a virtute: sicque non
equidem aliud est: & qui apud hos cofiten-
tur[?], non missam fecere Confessionem, neque
male eam ob ignorantiam peragunt, quod

page.notes: Catchword "ve-" and signature "Z 3" read at the foot. "insciti am" is a line-end spacing irregularity in the scan; read as "insciti-am" would be a guess, so left as printed spacing with "insciti am" and should be checked. "amathiæ" and "cofiten-tur" are doubtful readings, marked [?]. "Vvittembergenses" is printed as such. No running head, no notes in the margins.
